# v0.9.21

## 中文

### 更新内容

- 发布流程新增 GitCode 国内镜像：GitHub 构建并发布安装包后，会将同一版本标签和安装包同步到 GitCode Release。
- 同步流程先校验构建产物，再上传附件；确认附件齐全后才将 GitCode Release 标记为正式版本。

### 说明

- 本次更新的是发布流程。客户端内的更新源选择仍沿用现有方式；“自动 / GitHub / GitCode”选项尚未加入。

## English

### What's new

- Added a GitCode release mirror to the publishing workflow. After GitHub builds and publishes the installers, the same version tag and artifacts are synchronized to GitCode Releases.
- The workflow verifies the build artifacts before upload and marks the GitCode Release as final only after all expected files are present.

### Note

- This release changes the publishing workflow. The in-app update source selection is unchanged; the “Automatic / GitHub / GitCode” option is not included yet.
